sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the testing 
procedures for Communication System. The system is depending on a programming 
Logic Control System PLC control 
unit. The maximum capacity of the system is (96 line/36 Trunk) and the used 
capacity is (88 line/8 Trunk).

الأول 
مشروع بدأه المهندس. اسلام صبري 
reviewed 
& 
tested by 
eng. Ibrahim Mohamed Hefny on 07 Mar 2005, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Azab, and approved 
by eng. Fawzy Sobhy Ismael Head Sector of Abu Sultan Power Plant 4x150MW.
احتياطات السلامة

A work 
 order must be issued; the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety Category.

Safety 
 Fence with caution marks surrounding the work Area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical choke and 
 electrostatic effects.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Perform a visual inspection for PLC system
Use the multi-meter to check the 220v AC power source

افتح الغطاء الأمامي للوحة وتحقق من الرقم 4 باللون الأحمر 
 مصابيح LED

لاحظ مصابيح LED الخاصة بالطاقة التي تشير إلى الطاقة 
 دول جيدة

There 
 are 4 RED LED's for power states:
 * 220 فولت تيار متردد (جهد الإدخال) * 24 فولت تيار مستمر (جهد الخرج)
 * 12v DC (Output Voltage) 
 * 5v DC (Output Voltage)

قم بإيقاف تشغيل مصدر الطاقة عن طريق إيقاف التشغيل 
 مفتاح الطاقة الرئيسي.

Use the 
 vacuum cleaner to clean the 
 following parts: panel rack, electronic cards, battery bay.
Retighten the wirings and cards.

Switch on the power source by turning on 
 the main power switch and wait for the program to complete its loading 
 process.

Recheck the power 
 LED's for 220 VAC 
 input - and (24,12,5)VDC 
 Outputs.
